_source: Hand-written test fixture for the four read-only curated gbusiness tools (src/servers/gbusiness.ts), not a Discovery document and not a data/discovery/ snapshot: no refresh script reads tests/fixtures/discovery. Dated public REST references, all fetched 2026-11-19: reviews list https://developers.google.com/my-business/reference/rest/v4/accounts.locations.reviews/list (GET v4/{parent=accounts/*/locations/*}/reviews, pageSize maximum 50, orderBy rating, rating desc, updateTime desc); reviews get https://developers.google.com/my-business/reference/rest/v4/accounts.locations.reviews/get (GET v4/{name=accounts/*/locations/*/reviews/*}, only the name path parameter); localPosts list https://developers.google.com/my-business/reference/rest/v4/accounts.locations.localPosts/list (GET v4/{parent=accounts/*/locations/*}/localPosts, default pageSize 20, minimum 1, maximum 100); localPosts get https://developers.google.com/my-business/reference/rest/v4/accounts.locations.localPosts/get (GET v4/{name=accounts/*/locations/*/localPosts/*}, only the name path parameter). Both candidate public Discovery URLs, https://www.googleapis.com/discovery/v1/apis/mybusiness/v4/rest and https://mybusiness.googleapis.com/$discovery/rest?version=v4, returned HTTP 404 on 2026-11-19 by unauthenticated fetch. Only the paths, verbs, parameters and page limits the reference pages state are written here; response schemas and envelopes are deliberately not invented. For tests/curated-contract.test.mjs.
name: mybusiness
title: My Business API v4 (four curated reads)

list.description: Lists all reviews for a specified location.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of reviews to return. The maximum pageSize is 50.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: A page token from a previous list call.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: Optional. Sort order for results: rating, rating desc or updateTime desc.

get.description: Gets a review. The name is the review's full resource name.

list.description: Lists the local posts of a specified location.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The number of posts to return. Default 20, minimum 1, maximum 100.

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: A page token from a previous list call.

get.description: Gets a local post. The name is the post's full resource name.
